name: io.github.DivoomDevelop/mcp-divoom-lan
description: Control TimesFrame/AstroToo watchfaces, PIXOO64 and TimeGate 400/402 display elements and commands over LAN.
title: Divoom LAN Watchface

environmentVariables.name: DIVOOM_DEVICE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Optional default Divoom device LAN IP address. Omit it and pass target.host per tool call to control multiple devices.

environmentVariables.name: DIVOOM_DEVICE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Optional port override. Omit for automatic selection: PIXOO64 90/92 and TimeGate 400 use 80; other supported hardware uses 9000.

environmentVariables.name: DIVOOM_DEVICE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Product mode: auto, timesframe, astrotoo, pixoo64 or timegate. PIXOO64/TimeGate use discovery Hardware or DIVOOM_DEVICE_HARDWARE.

environmentVariables.name: DIVOOM_DEVICE_HARDWARE
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit hardware: PIXOO64 90/92/96 or TimeGate 400/402. Must match the actual default device.

environmentVariables.name: DIVOOM_TIMEGATE_LOCAL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional TimeGate LocalToken from device settings, used only for the matching default host. Otherwise pass localToken per call.
